lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Diagram five characters and the central conflict for acts read so far.

FEEDBACK
Strong answer: Relationships labelled; conflict is textual, not a movie memory.

CHECK
Mixing film-only plot into the play text. Separate adaptations later.

Update a plot/character tracker after reading; add two status-shift evidences.
